subject: Current-head rebase, cross-domain structural triangulation, and worker pickup constraints for the VoiceMem donor corpus

rebase_observations.aggregate_state_warning: workpackages/STATE.json is a cache and was observed materially behind granular active pointers. Workers must resolve active/<WP>.json plus reconciliation/receipt before treating aggregate phase labels as current.
rebase_observations.consequence: VoiceMem packets are successor/falsifier/research input for these scopes, not permission to rebuild or silently advance generations.
rebase_observations.wp904_gap: Earlier VoiceMem routing names F2-WP-904 as a natural failure-injection destination, but no current workpackages/active/F2-WP-904.json or repository code-search hit was observed. Treat F2-WP-904 as a conceptual/unmaterialized route only. Do not invent that workpackage or mutation authority. Run new failure-injection work through an existing accepted harness only when its contract permits, or claim the smallest genuinely unowned successor/test workpackage under CLAIM_PROTOCOL.md.

highest_value_worker_sequence.why_now: Full-source donor sweep reproduced that retrieved user/external memory can be rendered into a system-role message. This is a security/authority boundary and is orthogonal to semantic retrieval quality.
highest_value_worker_sequence.safe_worker_action: Create an inert held-out context-authority fixture: identical memory payload under explicit low-authority MEMORY/EVIDENCE typing versus system-role prose. Verify rendering/selection cannot elevate source capability, and keep EffectGate independent. Prefer review/falsifier work around accepted WP306/WP800 before any implementation mutation.
highest_value_worker_sequence.success: No user/external memory obtains instruction/effect authority merely through retrieval/rendering; exact source-role metadata survives to the consuming model-call/context receipt.
highest_value_worker_sequence.failure: Instruction-shaped retrieved data changes authority, replaces developer/system policy, or loses its source class.

highest_value_worker_sequence.why_now: VoiceMem local discriminator showed daemon-thread start is not durable persistence and abrupt process exit can lose the write.
highest_value_worker_sequence.safe_worker_action: Against existing WP103/WP104 boundaries, test a typed write lifecycle with exact causal identity: QUEUED -> STARTED -> CANONICAL_COMMITTED -> PROJECTIONS_PENDING/COMPLETE or FAILED/UNCOMMITTED. Do not reopen accepted delivery/deferred-return implementations without executable counterevidence.
highest_value_worker_sequence.success: After each injected shutdown/restart timing, every write identity resolves to durable committed state or explicit non-committed state; UI/session state cannot imply persistence without receipt.
highest_value_worker_sequence.failure: Acknowledged/enqueued work disappears while still being represented as remembered/delivered.

highest_value_worker_sequence.why_now: Donor source allowed same slot label to reuse vectors across embedder instances and allowed unequal dimensions to proceed through zip-based dot product.
highest_value_worker_sequence.safe_worker_action: Run a two-model/two-dimension and same-dimension/different-model cache fixture. Bind model/embedder/build/schema/dimension into cache identity and require fail-closed comparison on incompatible representations.
highest_value_worker_sequence.success: No cache hit crosses representation identity and vector comparison cannot silently truncate.
highest_value_worker_sequence.failure: Same label or equal dimension is sufficient to reuse semantically incompatible vectors.

highest_value_worker_sequence.why_now: This is the highest upside architectural donor: structure grows from repeated real retrieval use rather than only ingest-time taxonomy.
highest_value_worker_sequence.safe_worker_action: Do NOT mutate accepted WP301 retrieval. Build a versioned noncanonical ProjectionStrategyCandidate evaluated in WP800-style held-out micro-worlds. Compare against shuffled co-activation, popularity-matched and static-taxonomy controls; include revert metadata.
highest_value_worker_sequence.success: Held-out utility improves while rare-but-important evidence recall and epistemic safety do not regress; gains survive popularity/query-leak controls.
highest_value_worker_sequence.failure: Apparent gains vanish under held-out controls or self-reinforcing retrieval monopolizes future structure.

highest_value_worker_sequence.why_now: VoiceMem scene triggers generalize to prospective memory, while accepted WP203 AgencyState and WP205 Wake/HOLD already provide the correct F2 authority boundaries.
highest_value_worker_sequence.safe_worker_action: Represent condition-bound open-loop re-entry as a separate candidate/integration layer over accepted WP203/WP205; exact cue can propose revisit only. Near-match, stale generation, contradictory observation and unknown observation must abstain. No direct effect path.
highest_value_worker_sequence.success: Fresh exact evidence yields bounded revisit candidate; all ambiguity/staleness/near-miss cases remain HOLD/ABSTAIN.
highest_value_worker_sequence.failure: Cue matching schedules or executes a real effect, or soft context similarity substitutes for exact condition evidence.

cross_domain_transfer.primary_reference: Idreos, Kersten, Manegold, Database Cracking, CIDR 2007
cross_domain_transfer.structural_match: Database cracking reorganizes physical access structure incrementally along actual query workload rather than requiring a complete static index design up front.
cross_domain_transfer.transfer_lesson: Real use can be a signal for how a projection/index should organize itself, but workload feedback must be isolated from canonical truth and tested against popularity lock-in.

cross_domain_transfer.primary_reference: McCarthy & Dayal, The architecture of an active database management system, SIGMOD 1989
cross_domain_transfer.structural_match: Event-Condition-Action separates triggering event, evaluated condition and subsequent action.
cross_domain_transfer.transfer_lesson: EntityOS should keep the same separation but add a stronger authority break: event+condition may produce ActionCandidate/ReentryCandidate; only EffectGate/EffectJournal can authorize and record real effects.

cross_domain_transfer.voice_mem_pattern: Derived summaries/projections that follow canonical updates
cross_domain_transfer.primary_reference: Gupta, Mumick, Subrahmanian, Maintaining views incrementally, SIGMOD 1993
cross_domain_transfer.structural_match: Derived views are maintained from base-relation changes rather than becoming independent truth stores.
cross_domain_transfer.transfer_lesson: Graph/vector/summary/J-Space projections should be rebuildable derived surfaces with explicit source generation/digest and stale-write rejection.

cross_domain_transfer.voice_mem_pattern: High model confidence may still be wrong
cross_domain_transfer.primary_reference: Guo, Pleiss, Sun, Weinberger, On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks, ICML 2017
cross_domain_transfer.structural_match: Classifier confidence need not equal empirical correctness probability.
cross_domain_transfer.transfer_lesson: Emotion, familiarity, identity and other perceptual scores remain measurements/candidates until calibrated and combined with provenance/quality; a 1.00 softmax-like score is not identity or truth authority.

worker_pickup_contract.step_1: Refresh exact F2 main and exact granular active/reconciliation state for the target workpackage.
worker_pickup_contract.step_2: Read VOICEMEM_WORKER_ROUTING_INDEX plus only the packet sections relevant to the claimed scope.
worker_pickup_contract.step_3: If target generation is already ACCEPTED, default to REVIEW_ONLY/CANDIDATE_FALSIFIER or a separately justified successor scope; new worker/new chat is not new generation.
worker_pickup_contract.step_4: State donor observation, F2 hypothesis, serious counterhypothesis and cheapest discriminator before mutation.
worker_pickup_contract.step_5: Prefer deterministic/held-out/source-bound fixtures before provider/runtime cost.
worker_pickup_contract.step_6: Record negative evidence and exact evidence ceiling. Donor behavior, local donor tests and repository CI do not mint target-runtime/product credit.
worker_pickup_contract.step_7: If a useful new workpackage is genuinely absent, follow CLAIM_PROTOCOL.md create-only semantics; never infer authority from a routing label such as F2-WP-904.

global_boundaries: No VoiceMem left-brain/right-brain databases become a second EntityOS truth authority.
No co-activation cluster, trait, summary, familiarity score, recurrence score or model output mints FACT.
No memory/cue/speculation path bypasses deterministic effect authority.
No destructive consolidation may erase provenance, source authority or superseded history.
No aggregate STATE cache outranks exact granular active/reconciliation/receipt evidence.
No accepted component is reopened solely because a donor has a superficially similar feature.
evidence_boundary: This handoff combines exact F2 granular repository observations, VoiceMem source findings from the uploaded/public exact source snapshot, and cross-domain primary-literature analogies. Cross-domain structural similarity is transfer evidence only, not proof that the mechanism improves Frankenstein 2.0. No target runtime/provider/effect/training/whole-system credit is created.
